title.zh: 卷八十五 列傳第十五: 蕭撻凜 蕭觀音奴 耶律題子 耶律諧理 耶律奴瓜 蕭柳 高勳 奚和朔奴 蕭塔列葛 耶律撒合
title.en: Volume 85 Biographies 15: Xiao Talin, Xiao Guanyinnu, Yelu Tizi, Yelu Xieli, Yelu Nugua, Xiao Liu, Gao Xun, Xi Heshuonu, Xiao Taliege, Yelu Sahe
title.raw: 卷八十五 列傳第十五: 蕭撻凜 蕭觀音奴 耶律題子 耶律諧理 耶律奴瓜 蕭柳 高勳 奚和朔奴 蕭塔列葛 耶律撒合 Volume 85 Biographies 15: Xiao Talin, Xiao Guanyinnu, Yelu Tizi, Yelu Xieli, Yelu Nugua, Xiao Liu, Gao Xun, Xi Heshuonu, Xiao Taliege, Yelu Sahe

sentences.zh: 蕭撻凜蕭觀音奴耶律題子耶律諧理耶律奴瓜蕭柳高勛奚和朔奴蕭塔列葛耶律撒合

translations.literal: Xiao Talin, Xiao Guanyinnu, Yelu Tizi, Yelu Xieli, Yelu Nugua, Xiao Liu, Gao Xun, Xi Heshuonu, Xiao Taliege, Yelu Sahe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Talin, Xiao Guanyinnu, Yelu Tizi, Yelu Xieli, Yelu Nugua, Xiao Liu, Gao Xun, Xi Heshuonu, Xiao Taliege, and Yelu Sahe.

sentences.zh: 蕭撻凜，字駝寧，思溫之再從侄。

translations.literal: Xiao Talin, style name Tuoning, was a second cousin once removed of Siwen.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Talin, whose style name was Tuoning, was a second cousin once removed of Xiao Siwen.

sentences.zh: 父術魯列，善相馬，應歷間為馬群侍中。

translations.literal: His father Shululie was skilled at judging horses; during the Yingli reign he served as Commissioner of Horse Herds.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shululie was an expert judge of horses and, during the Yingli era, held the post of Commissioner of Horse Herds.

sentences.zh: 撻凜幼敦厚，有才略，通天文。

translations.literal: Talin in youth was sincere and steady, possessed talent and strategy, and understood astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Talin was earnest and steady, gifted with strategic ability, and versed in astronomy.

sentences.zh: 保寧初，為宿直官，累任珝劇。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he became a palace duty officer and was repeatedly assigned to Xuju.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Baoning era he entered palace service as a duty officer and was repeatedly posted to Xuju.

sentences.zh: 統和四年，宋楊繼業率兵由代州來侵，攻陷城邑。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, Song general Yang Ye led troops from Dai Prefecture in an invasion and captured cities and towns.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe (986), the Song general Yang Ye marched from Dai Prefecture to invade Liao territory and seized a number of towns.

sentences.zh: 撻凜以諸軍副部署，從樞密使耶律斜軫敗之，擒繼業於朔州。

translations.literal: Talin served as deputy commander of all armies and, following Grand Councilor Yelu Xiezhen, defeated them and captured Ye at Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Talin served as deputy commander of the combined armies and, under Grand Councilor Yelu Xiezhen, routed the Song force and took Yang Ye prisoner at Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 六年秋，改南院都監，從駕南征，攻沙堆，力戰被創，太后嘗親臨視。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixth year he was made Chief Supervisor of the Southern Chancellery; he accompanied the campaign south, assaulted Shadui, fought fiercely and was wounded, and the Empress Dowager once came in person to visit him.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn of the sixth year he was appointed Chief Supervisor of the Southern Chancellery. On the southern campaign he attacked Shadui, fought hard, and was wounded; the Empress Dowager herself came to see him.

sentences.zh: 明年，加右監門衛上將軍、檢校太師，遙授彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: The next year he was given the additional titles of General-in-Chief of the Right Gate Guards and Honorary Grand Preceptor, and was appointed in absentia Military Commissioner of Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he received the additional ranks of General-in-Chief of the Right Gate Guards and Honorary Grand Preceptor, with a concurrent appointment as Military Commissioner of the Zhangde circuit.

sentences.zh: 十一年，與東京留守蕭恒德伐高麗，破之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, together with Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde he attacked Goryeo and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde in a campaign against Goryeo and broke their resistance.

sentences.zh: 高麗稱臣奉貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo submitted as a vassal and sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo acknowledged vassal status and began sending tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年，夏人梗邊，皇太妃受命總烏古及永興宮分軍討之，撻凜為阻卜都詳穩。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Tangut blocked the frontier; the Imperial Consort was ordered to command the Ugu and Yongxing Palace divisional armies to punish them, and Talin served as Chief Commander of the Zubu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the Tangut raided the borderlands. The Imperial Consort was entrusted with the Ugu and Yongxing Palace forces to suppress them, and Talin was made Chief Commander of the Zubu tribes.

sentences.zh: 凡軍中號令，太妃並委撻凜。

translations.literal: All military orders in the army the Imperial Consort entrusted entirely to Talin.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Consort placed all military orders in Talin's hands.

sentences.zh: 師還，以功加兼侍中，封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: When the army returned, for his merit he was given the additional post of Vice Grand Councilor and enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was rewarded with the additional office of Vice Grand Councilor and enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 十五年，敵烈部人殺詳穩而叛，遁於西北荒，撻凜將輕騎逐之，因討阻卜之未服者，諸蕃歲貢方物充於國，自後往來若一家焉。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year men of the Dilie tribe killed their commander and rebelled, fleeing into the northwestern wastes; Talin led light cavalry in pursuit and, while at it, chastised unsubmissive Zubu; the various tribes thereafter sent yearly tribute goods that filled the state treasury, and from then on their coming and going was as one household.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the Dilie tribe murdered their commander and rebelled, fleeing into the far northwest. Talin led light cavalry in pursuit and, in the same campaign, subdued recalcitrant Zubu groups. Thereafter the frontier tribes sent annual tribute that filled the royal stores, and their relations with the court became as close as a single household.

sentences.zh: 上賜詩嘉獎，仍命林牙耶律昭作賦，以述其功。

translations.literal: The emperor bestowed a poem in praise and further ordered Academician Yelu Zhao to compose a fu describing his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted him a commendatory poem and ordered Academician Yelu Zhao to compose a fu celebrating his achievements.

sentences.zh: 撻凜以諸部叛服不常，上表乞建三城以絕邊患，從之。

translations.literal: Talin, because the various tribes' submission and rebellion were inconstant, memorialized requesting the building of three walled towns to cut off frontier troubles, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Because frontier tribes shifted unpredictably between rebellion and submission, Talin memorialized asking to build three fortified towns to end border unrest, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 俄召為南京統軍使。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned to be Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to serve as Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二十年，復伐宋，擒其將王先知，破其軍於遂城，下祁州，上手詔獎諭。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he again attacked Song, captured their general Wang Xianzhi, routed their army at Suicheng, and took Qizhou; the emperor sent a personal edict of reward and praise.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he again campaigned against Song, captured the Song general Wang Xianzhi, destroyed their army at Suicheng, and seized Qizhou; the emperor issued a personal edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 進至澶淵，宋主軍於城隍間，未接戰，撻凜按視地形，取宋之羊觀、鹽堆、鳧雁，中伏弩，卒。

translations.literal: Advancing to Chanyuan, the Song ruler stationed his army between the walls and moat; before battle was joined Talin inspected the terrain and took Song positions at Yangguan, Yandui, and Fuyan, but was struck by a hidden crossbow and died.
translations.idiomatic: The army pressed on to Chanyuan, where the Song emperor had drawn up his forces between the city walls and moat. Before battle was joined, Talin reconnoitered the ground and seized the Song outposts at Yangguan, Yandui, and Fuyan, but was killed by a concealed crossbow.

sentences.zh: 明日，彗車至，太后哭之慟，輟朝五日。

translations.literal: The next day the bier arrived; the Empress Dowager wept bitterly for him and suspended court for five days.
translations.idiomatic: The next day his funeral carriage arrived at court. The Empress Dowager mourned him deeply and suspended audiences for five days.

sentences.zh: 子慥古，南京統軍使。

translations.literal: His son Zhaogu became Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhaogu later served as Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 蕭觀音奴，字耶寧，奚王搭紇之孫。

translations.literal: Xiao Guanyinnu, style name Yening, was grandson of the Xi King Dage.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Guanyinnu, whose style name was Yening, was a grandson of the Xi King Dage.

sentences.zh: 統和十二年，為右祗候郎君班詳穩，遷奚六部大王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Tonghe he became Commander of the Right Palace Attendant Gentlemen Company and was transferred to Great King of the Six Xi Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Tonghe he was made commander of the Right Palace Attendant Gentlemen Company and then promoted to Great King of the Six Xi Divisions.

sentences.zh: 先是，俸秩外，給獐鹿百數，皆取於民，觀音奴奏罷之。

translations.literal: Previously, beyond regular salary, he was supplied with hundreds of roe deer and elk, all taken from the people; Guanyinnu memorialized to abolish this.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in addition to his regular salary, he had been supplied with hundreds of roe deer and elk levied from the populace; Guanyinnu memorialized to end the practice.

sentences.zh: 及伐宋，與蕭撻凜為先鋒，降祁州，下德清軍，上加優賞。

translations.literal: When they attacked Song, he and Xiao Talin served as vanguard, reduced Qizhou, and took Deqing Army; the emperor added special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against Song he and Xiao Talin led the vanguard, compelled the surrender of Qizhou, and captured Deqing Army; the emperor granted him exceptional rewards.

sentences.zh: 同知南院事，卒。

translations.literal: He became Associate Director of Southern Chancellery affairs and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Associate Director of the Southern Chancellery and later died.

sentences.zh: 耶律題子，字勝隱，北府宰相兀裏之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Tizi, style name Shengyin, was grandson of Northern Chancellery Chancellor Wuli.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Tizi, whose style name was Shengyin, was a grandson of Northern Chancellery Chancellor Wuli.

sentences.zh: 善射，工畫。

translations.literal: He was skilled at archery and accomplished at painting.
translations.idiomatic: He was an expert archer and a skilled painter.

sentences.zh: 保寧間，為禦盞郎君。

translations.literal: During Baoning he served as Imperial Cup Bearer Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: During the Baoning era he served as an Imperial Cup Bearer Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 九年，奉使於漢，具言兩國通好長久之計，其主繼元深加禮重。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was sent on mission to Han and set forth in full a long-term plan for friendly relations between the two states; their ruler Jiyuan treated him with deep courtesy and respect.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was dispatched as envoy to the Han state, where he laid out a long-term plan for enduring peace between the two realms; the Han ruler Liu Jiyuan received him with exceptional honor.

sentences.zh: 統和二年，將兵與西邊詳穩耶律速撒討陀羅斤，大破之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tonghe he led troops with Western Frontier Commander Yelu Susa to chastise the Tuoluojin and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tonghe he took command alongside Western Frontier Commander Yelu Susa to attack the Tuoluojin and routed them decisively.

sentences.zh: 四年，宋將楊繼業陷山西城邑，題子從北院樞密使耶律斜軫擊之，敗賀令圖於定安，授西南面招討都監。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Song general Yang Ye seized cities and towns in Shanxi; Tizi followed Northern Chancellery Grand Councilor Yelu Xiezhen to strike him, defeated He Lingtu at Ding'an, and was appointed Chief Commander of Southwestern Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when the Song general Yang Ye overran towns in Shanxi, Tizi marched under Northern Chancellery Grand Councilor Yelu Xiezhen, defeated He Lingtu at Ding'an, and was appointed Chief Commander of Southwestern Pacification.

sentences.zh: 宋兵守蔚州急，召外援，題子聞之，夜伏兵道傍。

translations.literal: Song troops defended Weizhou desperately and called for outside aid; hearing this, Tizi by night set an ambush along the road.
translations.idiomatic: The Song garrison at Weizhou was hard pressed and called for reinforcements. Hearing of this, Tizi laid an ambush along the road by night.

sentences.zh: 黎明，宋兵果來，過未半而擊之；

translations.literal: At dawn Song troops indeed came; before half had passed he struck them;
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the Song relief column appeared; he attacked before even half the column had passed;

sentences.zh: 城中軍出，斜軫復邀之。

translations.literal: the troops in the city came out, and Xiezhen again intercepted them.
translations.idiomatic: and when the city's defenders sallied forth, Xiezhen intercepted them as well.

sentences.zh: 兩軍俱潰，奔飛狐，地隘不得進，殺傷甚眾。

translations.literal: Both armies were routed and fled toward Feihu; the ground was narrow and they could not advance, and casualties were very heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Both Song columns broke and fled toward Feihu Pass, but the narrow terrain blocked their escape and the slaughter was immense.

sentences.zh: 賀令圖復集敗卒來襲蔚州，題子逆戰，破之，應州守將自遁。

translations.literal: He Lingtu again gathered defeated soldiers to assault Weizhou; Tizi met them in battle, defeated them, and the Yingzhou garrison commander fled of his own accord.
translations.idiomatic: He Lingtu rallied his broken troops to strike Weizhou again; Tizi met him in battle and crushed the force, after which the Yingzhou garrison commander fled on his own.

sentences.zh: 進圍寰州，冒矢石登城，宋軍大潰。

translations.literal: He advanced to besiege Huanzhou, braved arrows and stones to mount the wall, and the Song army collapsed in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed on to besiege Huanzhou, scaled the walls under a hail of missiles, and the Song army collapsed in rout.

sentences.zh: 當斜軫擒繼業於朔州，題子功居多。

translations.literal: When Xiezhen captured Ye at Shuozhou, Tizi's contribution was the greater part.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiezhen took Yang Ye prisoner at Shuozhou, the greater share of the credit belonged to Tizi.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，復與蕭撻凜由東路擊宋，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: That winter he again joined Xiao Talin on the eastern route to attack Song and took very many captives.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he again joined Xiao Talin on the eastern route against Song and took a great number of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 後聞宋兵屯易州，率兵逆之，至易境而卒。

translations.literal: Later, hearing Song troops were encamped at Yizhou, he led troops to meet them and died on reaching the Yi border.
translations.idiomatic: Later, learning that Song forces were encamped at Yizhou, he marched to intercept them but died upon reaching the Yi frontier.

sentences.zh: 初，題子破令圖，宋將有因傷而仆，題子繪其狀以示宋人，咸嗟神妙。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Tizi defeated Lingtu, a Song general had fallen from wounds; Tizi painted his likeness to show the Song men, and all sighed at its marvelous skill.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, after defeating He Lingtu, Tizi had seen a wounded Song officer collapse in the field. He painted the man's likeness and showed it to captured Song troops, who marveled at the portrait's uncanny accuracy.

sentences.zh: 耶律奴瓜，字延寧，太祖異母弟南府宰相蘇之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Nugua, style name Yanning, was grandson of Su, Southern Chancellery Chancellor and the Founding Emperor's younger half-brother.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Nugua, whose style name was Yanning, was a grandson of Su, Southern Chancellery Chancellor and younger half-brother of the dynastic founder.

sentences.zh: 有膂力，善調鷹隼。

translations.literal: He had great physical strength and was skilled at training hawks and falcons.
translations.idiomatic: He possessed exceptional strength and was adept at training hawks and falcons.

sentences.zh: 統和四年，宋楊繼業來侵，奴瓜為黃皮室糺都監，擊敗之，盡復所陷城邑。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when Song's Yang Ye came to invade, Nugua as Chief Commander of the Yellow Pishi Regiment defeated him and fully recovered the lost cities and towns.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe, when Yang Ye invaded from Song territory, Nugua—then chief of the Yellow Pishi Regiment—defeated him and recovered every town the Song had taken.

sentences.zh: 軍還，加諸衛小將軍。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was given the rank of Junior General of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was promoted to Junior General of the Guards.

sentences.zh: 及伐宋，有功，遷黃皮室詳穩。

translations.literal: When they attacked Song he had merit and was transferred to Commander of the Yellow Pishi.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against Song he distinguished himself and was made Commander of the Yellow Pishi.

sentences.zh: 六年，再舉，將先鋒軍，敗宋遊兵於定州，為東京統軍使，加金紫崇祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on a renewed campaign, he led the vanguard army, defeated Song skirmishers at Dingzhou, became Eastern Capital Commander-in-Chief, and was given the title of Golden Purple Glory Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on a renewed invasion, he commanded the vanguard, routed Song scouts at Dingzhou, was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Eastern Capital, and received the rank of Golden Purple Glory Grandee.

sentences.zh: 從奚王和朔奴伐兀惹，以戰失利，削金紫崇祿階。

translations.literal: Following the Xi King Heshuonu in attacking the Wunai, he suffered defeat in battle and was stripped of his Golden Purple Glory rank.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Xi King Heshuonu against the Wunai tribe but met defeat and was demoted from his Golden Purple Glory rank.

sentences.zh: 十九年，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Southern Chancellery Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，復伐宋，擒其將王繼忠於望都，俘殺甚眾，以功加同政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he again attacked Song, captured their general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu, and took or killed very many; for his merit he was given the additional post of Associate Director of the Directorate of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he again campaigned against Song, captured the Song general Wang Jizhong at Wangdu, and killed or took a great multitude of prisoners; for this he was made Associate Director of the Directorate of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，為遼興軍節度使，尋復為南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he became Military Commissioner of Liaoxing Army and soon again became Southern Chancellery Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was made Military Commissioner of the Liaoxing circuit and soon returned to the chancellorship of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，加尚父，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaitai he was given the title of Esteemed Father and died.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kaitai era he received the honorific title of Esteemed Father and soon after died.

sentences.zh: 蕭柳，字徒門，淳欽皇后弟阿古只五世孫。

translations.literal: Xiao Liu, style name Tumen, was fifth-generation descendant of Aguzhi, younger brother of Empress Chunqin.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Liu, whose style name was Tumen, was a fifth-generation descendant of Aguzhi, younger brother of Empress Chunqin.

sentences.zh: 幼養於伯父排押之家，多知，能文，膂力絕人。

translations.literal: Raised in youth in the household of his paternal uncle Paiya, he was broadly learned, could write, and his strength surpassed other men.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised in the household of his uncle Paiya, became widely learned, wrote well, and possessed strength beyond ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 統和中，叔父恒德臨終，薦其才，詔入侍衛。

translations.literal: During Tonghe, as his uncle Hengde was dying he recommended his talent, and an edict brought him into the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tonghe era his uncle Hengde, on his deathbed, recommended his abilities, and an edict brought him into the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 十七年，南伐，宋將範庭召列方陣而待。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, on the southern campaign, Song general Fan Tingzhao drew up a square formation and waited.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the southern campaign, the Song general Fan Tingzhao drew up his troops in a square formation and held his ground.

sentences.zh: 時皇弟隆慶為先鋒，問諸將佐誰敢當者，柳曰：「若得駿馬，則願為之先。」

translations.literal: At the time the emperor's younger brother Longqing was vanguard and asked which generals dared to meet them; Liu said, "If I may have a fine steed, I am willing to go first."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's younger brother Longqing commanded the vanguard and asked which officers would face the enemy formation. Liu said, "Give me a fine warhorse and I will lead the charge."

sentences.zh: 隆慶授以甲騎。

translations.literal: Longqing gave him armored cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing furnished him with armored cavalry.

sentences.zh: 柳攬轡，謂諸將曰：「陣若動，諸君急攻。」

translations.literal: Liu gathered the reins and told the generals, "If the formation moves, you all attack at once."
translations.idiomatic: Liu took the reins and told the other commanders, "When their line stirs, press the attack at once."

sentences.zh: 遂馳而前，敵少卻。

translations.literal: Then he galloped forward and the enemy fell back slightly.
translations.idiomatic: He then charged forward, and the enemy line gave ground.

sentences.zh: 隆慶席勢攻之，南軍遂亂。

translations.literal: Longqing pressed the advantage and attacked; the southern army was thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing exploited the opening and attacked, and the Song army broke into disorder.

sentences.zh: 柳中流矢，裹創而戰，眾皆披靡。

translations.literal: Liu was struck by a stray arrow, bound his wound and kept fighting, and the enemy masses were routed.
translations.idiomatic: Liu was struck by a stray arrow, bound the wound, and kept fighting until the enemy ranks collapsed.

sentences.zh: 時排押留守東京，奏柳為四軍兵馬都指揮使。

translations.literal: At the time Paiya was regent at the Eastern Capital and memorialized to make Liu Commander of the Four Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Paiya was then regent at the Eastern Capital and memorialized to appoint Liu Commander of the Four Armies.

sentences.zh: 明年，為北女直詳穩，政濟寬猛，部民畏愛。

translations.literal: The next year he became Commander of the Northern Jurchen; his governance balanced leniency and severity, and the tribesmen both feared and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was made Commander of the Northern Jurchen. His rule combined firmness with mercy, and the tribes both feared and cherished him.

sentences.zh: 遷東路統軍使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Eastern Route Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Commander-in-Chief of the Eastern Route.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，百姓願留復任，許之。

translations.literal: When his term ended the common people wished him to remain for another appointment, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired the people petitioned for his reappointment, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 從伐高麗，遇大蛇當路，前驅者請避；

translations.literal: On the campaign against Goryeo they met a great serpent blocking the road; the advance party asked to turn aside;
translations.idiomatic: On the Goryeo campaign the army encountered a huge serpent across the road, and the vanguard asked to go around it;

sentences.zh: 柳曰：「壯士安懼此！」

translations.literal: Liu said, "What brave man fears this!"
translations.idiomatic: Liu said, "What sort of brave man shrinks from this!"

sentences.zh: 拔劍斷蛇。

translations.literal: He drew his sword and cut the serpent in two.
translations.idiomatic: He drew his sword and cut the serpent in two.

sentences.zh: 師還致仕。

translations.literal: When the army returned he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 柳好滑稽，雖君臣燕飲，詼諧無所忌，時人比之俳優。

translations.literal: Liu loved jesting; even at court banquets between ruler and ministers his humor knew no restraint, and people of the time compared him to a performer.
translations.idiomatic: Liu loved jesting; even at formal banquets between emperor and ministers his wit knew no bounds, and contemporaries likened him to a court entertainer.

sentences.zh: 臨終，謂人曰：「吾少有致君誌，不能直遂，故以諧進。

translations.literal: Near death he told others, "In youth I had the ambition to serve the ruler; unable to advance by the straight path, I therefore advanced through humor.
translations.idiomatic: On his deathbed he told those around him, "In my youth I hoped to serve the throne directly; unable to advance by the straight path, I made my way through humor.

sentences.zh: 冀萬有一補，俳優名何避！」

translations.literal: I hoped that in ten thousand cases one might still be of use—why shrink from the name of performer!"
translations.idiomatic: I hoped that once in ten thousand jests something might still benefit the state—why should I shrink from being called a performer!"

sentences.zh: 頃之，被寢衣而坐，呼曰：「吾去矣！」

translations.literal: Shortly after, he put on his sleeping robe and sat upright, calling out, "I am going!"
translations.idiomatic: A moment later he put on his sleeping robe, sat upright, and cried, "I am leaving!"

sentences.zh: 言訖而逝。

translations.literal: With these words he passed away.
translations.idiomatic: With that he died.

sentences.zh: 耶律觀音奴集柳所著詩千篇，目曰《歲寒集》。

translations.literal: Yelu Guanyinnu collected a thousand poems Liu had written and titled the collection 《Winters Cold》.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Guanyinnu collected a thousand of Liu's poems into a collection titled 《Winters Cold》.

sentences.zh: 高勛，字鼎臣，晉北平王信韜之子。

translations.literal: Gao Xun, style name Dingchen, was son of Jin Prince of Beiping Xin Tao.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xun, whose style name was Dingchen, was a son of Xin Tao, Prince of Beiping under the Jin.

sentences.zh: 性通敏。

translations.literal: By nature he was quick and perceptive.
translations.idiomatic: He was quick-witted and perceptive by nature.

sentences.zh: 仕晉為閣門使。

translations.literal: He served Jin as Gate Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Jin he served as Gate Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會同九年，與杜重威來降。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Huitong he came to surrender with Du Chongwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Huitong (942) he surrendered to Liao together with Du Chongwei.

sentences.zh: 太宗入汴，授四方館使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizong entered Bian he was appointed Commissioner of the Four Directions Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong entered Bian (Kaifeng) he was appointed Commissioner of the Four Directions Bureau.

sentences.zh: 好結權貴，能服勤大臣，多推譽之。

translations.literal: He liked to cultivate ties with the powerful and could attend diligently on great ministers, who often praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He cultivated ties with powerful figures, served senior ministers diligently, and won their frequent praise.

sentences.zh: 天祿間，為樞密使，總漢軍事。

translations.literal: During Tianlu he became Grand Councilor and oversaw Han military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianlu era he became Grand Councilor with overall charge of Han military affairs.

sentences.zh: 五年，劉崇遣使來求封冊，詔勛冊崇為大漢神武皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Liu Chong sent envoys requesting investiture; an edict ordered Xun to invest Chong as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Liu Chong sent envoys requesting formal investiture, and the court ordered Xun to invest him as Emperor Shenwu of Great Han.

sentences.zh: 應歷初，封趙王，出為上京留守，尋移南京。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yingli he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao, went out as regent of the Supreme Capital, and soon was moved to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yingli era he was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao, appointed regent of the Supreme Capital, and soon transferred to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 會宋欲城益津，勛上書請假巡僥以擾之，帝然其奏，宋遂不果城。

translations.literal: When Song wished to fortify Yijin, Xun memorialized requesting leave to patrol the border and harass them; the emperor approved his memorial and Song therefore did not complete the fortification.
translations.idiomatic: When Song planned to fortify Yijin, Xun memorialized asking permission to patrol the frontier and harass their works. The emperor approved, and Song abandoned the project.

sentences.zh: 十七年，宋略地益津關，勛擊敗之，知南院樞密事。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Song seized territory around the Yijin passes; Xun defeated them and was made Director of Southern Chancellery Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, when Song forces seized ground around the Yijin passes, Xun defeated them and was appointed Director of Southern Chancellery Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 景宗即位，以定策功，進王秦。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, for his merit in settling the succession he was advanced to Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong ascended the throne, Xun was advanced to Prince of Qin for his role in securing the succession.

sentences.zh: 保寧中，以南京郊內多隙地，請疏畦種稻，帝欲從之。

translations.literal: During Baoning, because within the Southern Capital suburbs there was much vacant land, he requested to open fields and plant rice; the emperor wished to agree.
translations.idiomatic: During Baoning he noted much unused land in the Southern Capital suburbs and memorialized to open paddy fields; the emperor was inclined to approve.

sentences.zh: 林邪耶律昆宣言於朝曰：「高勛此奏，必有異志。

translations.literal: Academician Yelu Kun proclaimed at court, "This memorial of Gao Xun surely conceals a different intent.
translations.idiomatic: Academician Yelu Kun declared at court, "Gao Xun's proposal surely conceals ulterior motives.

sentences.zh: 果令種稻，引水為畦，設以京叛，官軍何自而入？」

translations.literal: If rice is indeed planted, drawing water for fields—suppose the capital rebels, how would government troops enter of themselves?"
translations.idiomatic: If rice fields are opened and irrigation ditches cut through the suburbs, and the capital then rebels, how will government troops enter at all?"

sentences.zh: 帝疑之，不納。

translations.literal: The emperor became suspicious and did not adopt it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor grew suspicious and rejected the plan.

sentences.zh: 尋遷南院樞密使。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Southern Chancellery Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Grand Councilor of the Southern Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以毒藥饋駙馬都尉蕭啜裏，事覺，流銅州。

translations.literal: He presented poison to Imperial Son-in-Law Xiao Chuoli; when the matter was discovered he was exiled to Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He sent poison to Imperial Son-in-Law Xiao Chuoli; when the plot was exposed he was exiled to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 尋又謀害尚書令蕭思溫，詔獄誅之，沒其產，皆賜思溫家。

translations.literal: Soon he again plotted to harm Chief Minister Xiao Siwen; by imperial order he was executed in prison, his property confiscated, and all given to Siwen's family.
translations.idiomatic: He soon plotted again, this time against Chief Minister Xiao Siwen. By imperial order he was executed in prison; his property was confiscated and given entirely to Siwen's family.

sentences.zh: 奚和朔奴，字籌寧，奚可汗之裔。

translations.literal: Xi Heshuonu, style name Chouning, was a descendant of the Xi khan.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Heshuonu, whose style name was Chouning, was a descendant of the Xi khans.

sentences.zh: 保寧中，為奚六部長。

translations.literal: During Baoning he was chief of the Six Xi Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: During Baoning he served as chief of the Six Xi Divisions.

sentences.zh: 統和初，皇太后稱制，以耶律休哥領南邊事，和朔奴為南面行軍副部署。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe the Empress Dowager held regency; Yelu Xiuge was put in charge of southern frontier affairs, and Heshuonu became Deputy Commander of the Southern Field Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tonghe, under the Empress Dowager's regency, Yelu Xiuge took charge of the southern frontier while Heshuonu was made Deputy Commander of the Southern Field Army.

sentences.zh: 四年，宋曹彬、米信等來侵，和朔奴與休哥破宋兵於燕南，手詔褒美。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Song's Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others came to invade; Heshuonu and Xiuge defeated Song troops south of Yan, and a personal edict praised them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when Song generals Cao Bin, Mi Xin, and others invaded, Heshuonu and Yelu Xiuge routed the Song army south of Yan, and the emperor sent them a personal edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 軍還，怙權撾無罪人李浩至死，上以其功釋之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, relying on power he beat the innocent man Li Hao to death; the emperor for his merit pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he abused his authority and beat the innocent Li Hao to death, but the emperor pardoned him because of his military service.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，南征，將本部軍由別道進擊敵軍於狼山，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year, on the southern campaign, he led his tribal army by a separate route to strike the enemy at Langshan and took very many captives.
translations.idiomatic: That winter of the sixth year, on the southern campaign, he led his tribal forces by a separate route to attack the enemy at Langshan and took a great number of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八年，上表曰：「臣竊見太宗之時，奚六部二宰相、二常袞，誥命大常袞班在酋長左右，副常袞總知酋長五房族屬，二宰相匡輔酋長，建明善事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he memorialized: "Your subject has observed that in Emperor Taizong's time the Six Xi Divisions had two chancellors and two changgun; edicts placed the senior changgun beside the chieftain, the deputy changgun oversaw the five clans of the chieftain's house, and the two chancellors supported the chieftain in establishing enlightened affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he memorialized: "Your subject observes that under Emperor Taizong the Six Xi Divisions had two chancellors and two changgun officers: the senior changgun was stationed at the chieftain's side by imperial appointment, the deputy changgun oversaw the five clans of the chieftain's lineage, and the two chancellors assisted the chieftain in governing well.

sentences.zh: 今宰相職如故，二常袞別無所掌，乞依舊制。」

translations.literal: Now the chancellor's duties remain as before, but the two changgun have nothing in charge; I beg to restore the old system."
translations.idiomatic: Today the chancellors' duties remain unchanged, but the two changgun have no defined responsibilities. I beg that the old system be restored."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his request.

sentences.zh: 十二年秋，遷都部署，伐兀惹。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twelfth year he was transferred to Capital Commander and attacked the Wunai.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn of the twelfth year he was promoted to Capital Commander and led a campaign against the Wunai.

sentences.zh: 駐於鐵驪，秣馬數月，進至兀惹城。

translations.literal: He encamped at Tieli, fed the horses for several months, then advanced to the Wunai city.
translations.idiomatic: He encamped at Tieli, rested and fed his horses for several months, then advanced to the Wunai capital.

sentences.zh: 利其俘掠，請降不許，令急攻之。

translations.literal: Coveting their plunder, he would not accept their surrender and ordered a swift assault.
translations.idiomatic: Greedy for plunder, he refused their surrender and ordered an immediate assault.

sentences.zh: 城中大恐，皆殊死戰。

translations.literal: The city was greatly terrified and all fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: The city was gripped by terror, and the defenders fought to the last man.

sentences.zh: 和朔奴知不能克，從副部署蕭恒德議，掠地東南，循高麗北界而還。

translations.literal: Heshuonu knew he could not take it; following Deputy Commander Xiao Hengde's counsel, he plundered southeastward and returned along Goryeo's northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that the city could not be taken, Heshuonu followed Deputy Commander Xiao Hengde's advice, raided southeastward, and withdrew along Goryeo's northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 以地遠糧絕，士馬死傷，詔降封爵，卒。

translations.literal: Because the distance was great and supplies ran out, soldiers and horses died or were wounded; by edict his noble rank was reduced, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: The expedition had marched too far and supplies failed; men and horses perished in great numbers. By edict his noble rank was reduced, and he soon died.

sentences.zh: 子烏也，郎君班詳穩。

translations.literal: His son Wuye became Commander of the Gentlemen Company.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wuye later served as commander of the Gentlemen Company.

sentences.zh: 蕭塔列葛，字雄隱，五院部人。

translations.literal: Xiao Taliege, style name Xiongyin, was a man of the Five-Yuan Division.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Taliege, whose style name was Xiongyin, came from the Five-Yuan Division.

sentences.zh: 八世祖只魯，遙輦氏時嘗為虞人。

translations.literal: His eighth-generation ancestor Zhilu during the Yaolian clan had served as Keeper of the Forest.
translations.idiomatic: His eighth-generation ancestor Zhilu had served as Keeper of the Imperial Forest during the Yaolian period.

sentences.zh: 唐安祿山來攻，只魯戰於黑山之陽，敗之。

translations.literal: When Tang's An Lushan came to attack, Zhilu fought on the southern slope of Black Mountain and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: When An Lushan of Tang attacked, Zhilu met him on the southern slope of Black Mountain and defeated his force.

sentences.zh: 以功為北府宰相，世預其選。

translations.literal: For his merit he became Northern Chancellery Chancellor; his descendants generation after generation were in that selection.
translations.idiomatic: For this achievement he was made Chancellor of the Northern Chancellery, and his descendants for generations held seats in that hereditary selection.

sentences.zh: 塔列葛仕開泰間，累遷西南面招討使。

translations.literal: Taliege served during Kaitai, rising repeatedly to Southwestern Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Taliege served during the Kaitai era and rose through repeated promotions to Commissioner of Southwestern Pacification.

sentences.zh: 重熙十一年，使西夏，諭伐宋事，約元昊出別道以會。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chongxi he was envoy to Western Xia, instructed them on attacking Song, and arranged for Yuan Hao to come by a separate route to join.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chongxi he was sent as envoy to Western Xia to discuss the campaign against Song and arranged for Yuan Hao to advance by a separate route to rendezvous with Liao forces.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改右夷離畢、同知南京留守，轉左夷離畢，俄授東京留守，以世選為北府宰相，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was made Right Yilibi and Associate Southern Capital Regent, transferred to Left Yilibi, soon appointed Eastern Capital Regent, then by hereditary selection Northern Chancellery Chancellor, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was appointed Right Yilibi and Associate Regent of the Southern Capital, then transferred to Left Yilibi, soon made Regent of the Eastern Capital, and finally elevated by hereditary selection to Chancellor of the Northern Chancellery before his death.

sentences.zh: 耶律撒合，字率懶，乙室部人，南府宰相歐禮斯子。

translations.literal: Yelu Sahe, style name Shuailan, was of the Yishi Division, son of Southern Chancellor Oulisi.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Sahe, whose style name was Shuailan, came from the Yishi Division and was a son of Southern Chancellery Chancellor Oulisi.

sentences.zh: 天祿間始仕。

translations.literal: He began service during Tianlu.
translations.idiomatic: He entered government service during the Tianlu era.

sentences.zh: 應歷中，拜乙室大王，兼知兵馬事。

translations.literal: During Yingli he was appointed Great King of Yishi and concurrently in charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During Yingli he was appointed Great King of the Yishi Division with concurrent authority over military affairs.

sentences.zh: 乾亨初，宋來侵，詔以本部兵守南京，與北院大王奚底、統軍蕭討古等逆戰，奚底等敗走，獨撒合全軍還。

translations.literal: Early in Qianheng, when Song invaded, an edict ordered his tribal troops to defend the Southern Capital; with Northern Chancellery Great King Xidi, Commander Xiao Taogu, and others he met them in battle; Xidi and others fled defeated, but Sahe alone returned with his army intact.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qianheng, when Song invaded, an edict ordered his tribal troops to defend the Southern Capital. He joined Northern Chancellery Great King Xidi, Commander Xiao Taogu, and others to meet the enemy; Xidi's forces were routed, but Sahe alone brought his army back intact.

sentences.zh: 上諭之曰：「拒敵當如此。

translations.literal: The emperor told him, "To resist the enemy should be like this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him, "This is how one should resist the enemy.

sentences.zh: 卿勉之，無憂不富貴。」

translations.literal: You exert yourself—do not worry that wealth and honor will not come."
translations.idiomatic: Press on, and you need not fear that wealth and honor will elude you."

sentences.zh: 加守太保。

translations.literal: He was given the additional post of Guardian Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He was then given the additional rank of Guardian Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 統和間卒。

translations.literal: He died during Tonghe.
translations.idiomatic: He died during the Tonghe era.

sentences.zh: 論曰：遼在統和間，數舉兵伐宋，諸將如耶律諧理、奴瓜、蕭柳等俱有降城擒將之功。

translations.literal: Commentary: During Tonghe Liao repeatedly raised armies against Song; generals such as Yelu Xieli, Nugua, and Xiao Liu all had achievements in reducing cities and capturing generals.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: During the Tonghe era Liao repeatedly campaigned against Song, and commanders such as Yelu Xieli, Yelu Nugua, and Xiao Liu all won renown for compelling cities to submit and capturing enemy generals.

sentences.zh: 最後以蕭撻凜為統軍，直抵澶淵。

translations.literal: Finally Xiao Talin was made commander-in-chief and pressed straight to Chanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the end Xiao Talin was made supreme commander and drove the army straight to Chanyuan.

sentences.zh: 將與宋戰，撻凜中弩，我兵失倚，和議始定。

translations.literal: Just as he was about to fight Song, Talin was struck by a crossbow bolt; our army lost its support, and the peace treaty was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Just as battle with Song was about to begin, Talin was struck down by a crossbow bolt. The Liao army lost its pillar of command, and the peace settlement followed.

sentences.zh: 或者天厭其亂，使南北之民休息者耶！

translations.literal: Perhaps Heaven tired of the chaos and wished the peoples of north and south to rest!
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps Heaven had grown weary of the turmoil and meant the peoples of north and south to find rest at last!
